title: Chapter 46 Gong Zheng'S Brother
content:
Chapter 46 Gong Zheng'S Brother

In this way, Wang Shuo obtained a huge amount of resources.

[Iron ore × 900, wood × 3000, stone × 1200, gold coins × 350, energy crystals × 100, and other resources. ]

Wang Shuo was a little sad that he did not get the important resources from Huang Feiguang.

These were all unexpected gains, and this wave was still a huge profit.

He looked at his gold coins again, and with the bronze key molds and other resources that he had consigned before, he had another 4950.

This made Wang Shuo a little overjoyed. At this time, there were still 35 sets of bronze key molds left for consignment. It seemed that some of them were not selling well, and almost all the ones that should be bought were bought.

At this moment, Wang Shuo could be said to be rich and powerful, and he was full of confidence in making it to the rankings.

In the evening, Wang Shuo returned to his territory and spent some materials and gold coins to repair the durability of the golden armor warrior.

Then he opened the [chat channel].

"We don't want to kill each other, we want peace!"

"I call on all parties to remain calm. This is just a test from Lord Zach. Don't do it!"

"Don't kill me. I have old people above me and young children below me."

The atmosphere in the chat channel was very strange. Few people were talking. It seemed that everyone was "very busy" and had no time to chat.

Wang Shuo had nothing to say and directly exited the chat channel.

The business that should be done should still be done.

Wang Shuo found Chef Zhang and sent a message: "Brother Chef, are you still alive?"

Chef Zhang's friend avatar did not turn gray, so he should still be alive.

After a while, Chef Zhang replied: "I'm still alive. I just killed someone."

Wang Shuo was silent for a moment and replied: "I killed too."

"This world is really forcing good people into prostitution!" Chef Zhang said bitterly.

Wang Shuo instantly lost the idea of continuing to do business!

At this time, he had only one thought, to quickly improve his combat strength and then survive.

The battle for the village construction order that will begin soon will definitely be more dangerous and cruel than this elimination match.

This game is a test of human nature in the most extreme situation.

Everyone has no choice.

After resting, Wang Shuo entered the ancient battlefield again in the afternoon.

At present, only this place can effectively improve his combat level.

When he came to Huangfeng Valley and found Zhao Bangde, Wang Shuo said directly: "I want to take the task."

Zhao Bangde saw that Wang Shuo was obviously different from yesterday.

"Have you killed a player?" Zhao Bangde asked in confusion.

Wang Shuo showed a trace of sadness on his face, and after a long while he slowly said: "Yes."

"It's not your fault. Just get used to it." Zhao Bangde comforted.

"I have two more tasks for you."

"One is an infinite task that can be accepted continuously. Every time you kill 100 monsters in the ancient battlefield, you will automatically be rewarded with 200 military merit points."

"The other is that if you kill a small BOSS, you can get 500 military merit points and an item."

"You currently have a golden armor warrior, and you have the strength to kill the big knife skeleton king 3 miles east of the camp."

[Quartermaster Zhao Bangde is issuing a task to you. Do you accept it? 】

"Accept."

Soon Wang Shuo adjusted his mentality and walked out of the camp with his subordinates.

The deeper into the Gobi Desert, the denser the skeleton soldiers are. There is no shortage of monsters at this time.

Wang Shuo went all the way east and killed the big knife skeleton king. Naturally, he did not let go of the small monsters along the way.

On a raised hillside, Wang Shuo saw the target of this trip.

A skeleton king holding a big knife, the bone knife in his hand is taller than his height, estimated to be more than 2 meters.

Reconnaissance.

[Skeleton King with a Big Knife]

[Level: Level 10]

[Attack Power: 300]

[Defense Power: 20]

[Health Points: 5000]

[Skills: Sweep through thousands of troops, charge a strike. ]

[Evaluation: A first-level undead boss in the ancient battlefield, powerful and with amazing defense. ]

Wang Shuo took a look and felt something was not good. This attack was too high!

At this time, the price paid for a strong attack must be very high.

Gong Zheng still lacked a good shield, while Wang Shuo lacked a handy weapon.

So, he decided to give up for the time being.

Let's kill the monsters first, and hone our combat skills and cooperation.

In this way, the two of them and the puppet began to slaughter crazily in the Gobi Desert.

The cycle mission was completed 3 times, and several ordinary skeleton kings were killed.

In this way, his military merit points also reached 1000 points.

...

In the evening, Huangfeng Valley camp.

Wang Shuo found Zhao Bangde and directly recruited two more tools.

These two people are Gong Zheng's brothers, named Gong Ping and Gong Kai.

Wang Shuo recruited these two brothers mainly because Gong Zheng said that when the three brothers are together, they will trigger a "brotherly unity" buff, which can increase each person's health, attack power and defense by 30%.

After hearing this, Wang Shuo opened his mouth wide, as if he had eaten an egg.

This buff is simply too much.

It is equivalent to a 1/3 increase in all states. When Gong Zheng mentioned this, Wang Shuo made up his mind to reunite the three brothers.

After the personnel were supplemented, the only thing left was equipment.

Wang Shuo led everyone back to the territory and settled down.

Then he came to the workshop and planned to make a batch of excellent equipment to improve the combat effectiveness of his team.

Iron ore, he now has 1,000 units, the material is sufficient.

Gong Zheng, who has been upgraded to level 5, Wang Shuo plans to make him a heavy shield to act as the front row, attract firepower and resist damage.

Gong Kai is good at using knives, while Gong Ping likes to use bows and arrows. The three brothers have their own strengths, and Wang Shuo has tailored equipment for them.

Wang Shuo himself made a spear. He has made up his mind to develop in the direction of a military commander. He can be familiar with horse kung fu and gun skills in advance.

It was not until late at night that Wang Shuo finished making all the equipment and the iron ore was exhausted.

The next morning, Wang Shuo couldn't wait to put the new equipment on the three brothers.

Although Gong Kai and Gong Ping are still level 2 minions.

But after wearing the new equipment, the momentum came out immediately, and there was a taste of elite.

It is necessary to upgrade as soon as possible and raise the level.

Arriving at the Huangfeng Valley camp, I saw Zhao Bangde exercising from a distance.

Wang Shuo did not step forward immediately, but waited patiently.

Zhao Bangde's boxing skills seemed to be slow, but in fact they were extremely powerful. They could mobilize the whole body's strength at one point and burst out amazing fighting power.

A quarter of an hour later, Zhao Bangde put away his fists, looked at Wang Shuo and his party, and joked: "You are finally not fighting alone now, haha!"

Wang Shuo laughed at himself, and then humbly asked: "Old Zhao, what do you think I should do next?"

Zhao Bangde touched his beard, pondered for a while, and said: "For me, only military merit points are useful, so your main task today is to go and clear out the skeleton soldiers on the Gobi Desert."

After that, he took a few steps, and then pretended to be mysterious and continued: "Go and earn military merit points! I have a few mysterious props here, you definitely want them."
